Liiga goals

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_goals.Rd

Every goal of a season and tournament: scorer, assists, strength codes and skaters on ice.

Usage

liiga_goals(season = NULL, tournament = NULL)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). Omitted = the season in progress.

tournament

Tournament: runkosarja (regular season), playoffs, playout, qualifications, valmistavat_ottelut (preseason) or chl (Champions Hockey League). Omitted = every tournament, preseason included.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (30 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
game_idintegerGame id, unique only within a season: key a game as (season, game_id).
sidecharacterWhich team of the game the row belongs to: home or away.
team_idintegerTeam id, the number of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key (sent as that string, a bare integer or a digit string depending on the route).
team_slugcharacterTeam slug, the part of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key after the colon (e.g. hpk).
log_timecharacterWall-clock time the event was logged, ISO 8601 UTC.
winning_goallogicalGame-winning goal.
game_timeintegerSeconds from the start of the game. Regular season: 3900 (65:00) = the end of the 5-minute overtime; playoff overtime runs past it.
periodintegerPeriod number: 1-3 are regulation, 4 and up overtime (or the shootout).
event_idintegerEvent id within the game.
home_team_scoreintegerHome score after the event.
away_team_scoreintegerAway score after the event.
goals_so_far_in_seasonintegerScorer's season goal count after this goal.
video_clip_urlcharacterURL of the goal's video clip; null in every capture.
video_clip_playlist_urlcharacterURL of the goal's video clip playlist; null in every capture.
video_thumbnail_urlcharacterURL of the goal video's thumbnail image; null in every capture.
scorer_player_idintegerScorer's player id.
scorer_first_namecharacterScorer's first name.
scorer_last_namecharacterScorer's last name.
assist1_player_idintegerFirst assist's player id.
assist1_first_namecharacterFirst assist's first name.
assist1_last_namecharacterFirst assist's last name.
assist1_season_assistsintegerFirst assister's season assist count after this goal.
assist2_player_idintegerSecond assist's player id.
assist2_first_namecharacterSecond assist's first name.
assist2_last_namecharacterSecond assist's last name.
assist2_season_assistsintegerSecond assister's season assist count after this goal.
goal_typescharacterGoal type codes, comma-separated Finnish abbreviations: YV power play, AV short-handed, TM empty net, RL penalty shot (others undocumented).
plus_jerseyscharacterJersey NUMBERS of this team's skaters on ice for the goal, space-separated.
minus_jerseyscharacterJersey NUMBERS of the other team's skaters on ice for the goal, space-separated.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/games

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_shootout(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_game_team_stats(), liiga_games(), liiga_gameweeks(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_game_log(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_shotmap(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_teams_history(), liiga_tournament()
